title: all-intra codec battery at matched quality (ssim2 mean 61.96 +-2)

provenance.source: benchmark/experiments/11-intra-codecs/battery.json (19 experiments + _meta) and one encoded sample per experiment under samples/; the battery script itself was not kept
provenance.notes: all encoders consume the same decoded pixels (PIL decode + letterbox to 488x680, the forge baseline pipeline); quality = SSIMULACRA2 on the fixed 96-item sample of measure_variants.py (numpy default_rng(7).choice(2048, 96)), decoded frame vs source PNG; calibration target = ssim2 mean 61.96 +-2 (svt-av1 preset 6 crf 35 tune=still, the av1-still-s6-crf35 baseline of measurements.json, reproduced byte-identically here: 70092669 bytes, p50 62.69) machine: macOS arm64 Apple Silicon, 10 logical cores; ffmpeg 9 (libsvtav1 4.2.0, x265, x264), avifenc 1.4.2 (aom 3.14.1), cjxl 0.12.0, cwebp 1.6.0, vvencapp 1.14.0. threads: wall clock, threads as recorded per entry: video codecs encode one stream (svt ladder pinned to lp=2 like the forge baseline; lp=8 bonus rows unlock threads), per-image codecs run 10 parallel single-threaded workers

notes: verdicts: most compact at equivalent quality = avif-s6-q48 (61434107 bytes, -12.4% vs the svt-p6 baseline; libaom still out-compresses svt-av1 all-intra); fastest inside the +-2 window = x264-crf31 (4.8 s wall); svt-p10-lp8 is faster (3.3 s) but sits 2.9 points below target.
svt presets 10 and 12 emit byte-identical streams: svt-av1 4.2 maps both to M9 for all-intra.

svt tune=3 is the real still-picture tune (Tune IQ, all-intra only): +1.26 ssim2 for +1.4% bytes. the forge probe resolved tune=still to 4 (MS_SSIM) because it probed without keyint=1; fixed, manifests record tune_resolved.
vvenc uses 10-bit internal coding, decoded with ffmpeg 9's native vvc decoder; 100x the cost of x264 for a mid-table size.
jpeg-xl operates in XYB (no 4:2:0 chroma subsampling); the cjxl d1/d2 rows are fixed-distance and sit far above the target quality, so their sizes are not comparable to the calibrated rows.
the svt-p6-crf35 row reproduces the av1-still-s6-crf35 variant of 02-av1-variants byte for byte (70092669 bytes).
